notes.title: Occupy Mars: The Game Kickstarter Campaign is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings, Fossil Hunters!

We’re excited to announce that we’re launching a Kickstarter campaign for Occupy Mars: The Game! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/f2e6958fdb2ab285f371fe20e7c4b220008b719b.png

Occupy Mars: The Game is a highly technical survival game about Mars colonization. As an astronaut who has just landed on the Red Planet, your task is to build and expand your base and survive in the harsh environment that is unlike the one on Earth.

[previewyoutube=ePLA8ljmeaI;full][/previewyoutube]

The game has been in development since 2017 and we’re finally nearing its completion! While Occupy Mars: The Game is almost ready for Early Access release, another challenge lies ahead – pre-release promotion. We have to make sure our voice is heard and the game makes its way to players, which is difficult for our still relatively small team. This campaign’s goal is to reach as many people as possible while gathering additional funds for marketing purposes.

That’s why we need your help!

While paleontology and space exploration might appear to be distant topics, what connects them is the knowledge and passion of enthusiasts such as yourself! Just like with Dinosaur Fossil Hunter, we’ve been doing a great deal of research when working on Occupy Mars: The Game and if you have any interest in Mars or space exploration as a whole, we’re sure you’ll find something for yourself here! :) Please consider supporting the campaign and tell your friends about it! 


 Learn more about the game and the campaign on its dedicated Kickstarter page
 Check out Steam store page of Occupy Mars: The Game
 Play the free Prologue version
 Watch Occupy Mars stream on our Twitch – LIVE NOW!

We thank you for all your support!

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Designer DLC coming on November 16
notes.content:
Hello, Fossil Hunters!

We have some exciting news for you! We’re happy to announce that our previously announced Designer DLC will be released on November 16!

[previewyoutube=Q13A2P5MtbQ;full]TRAILER[/previewyoutube]

This DLC introduces life-sized dinosaur models of every species currently present in the game, which you can paint any way you like! Dinosaur lovers fond of realistic portrayal can bring to life their favorite dinos and create amazing scenes with realistic colors and subtle details. On the other hand, those who are willing to let their imagination run wild can create unique designs for their dinos not seen anywhere else! Every approach is a good one. We only give you the tools to bring your ideas to life. ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/10428ac71a93c0e14cd1e9b28d7588e556556ca5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/20b1c5820b42060b3065da5e95c1292300945561.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/f93ea2f36a6ad4c63643fa8f97e6e66eef9cc189.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/5d072c0970173a21012d3fd3c1f2e07b743da97b.jpg  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/23bf101ae76c4d0a3932a19ad67b8d7a8553f6e6.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/211a653d77b3ad221e3325a972f076b04d6b0473.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/88f5db9d0c8951fbe5ad5aabcf385409ef87e396.png


We’re sure they’ll bring a lot of variety to your museum and we hope that with this small personal touch, your museum will become truly yours.

Designer DLC will include:

 10 Dinosaur species to paint
 10 poses for each Dinosaur species to arrange your display
 2 gameplay modes:
 Normal (which takes game progression into account)
 Sandbox (which allows you to paint every Dino from start)
 50+ textures for skin, scales etc...
 30+ skin patterns and decals
 20+ blood decals
 Full color palette
 130+ texture sets with skins
 20+ independent textures for free combination with skin textures
 30+ additional decals for museum decoration in 2 color variants


Remember to add Designer DLC to your Wishlist to receive a notification right away when it becomes available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065550/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter__Designer_DLC/

We’re already working on additional content! More info soon! :)

Stay tuned!

Kind Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter now available!
notes.content:
Dear Fossil Hunters!

At last, the time has come and our countdown comes to a close!

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter is now available on Steam! 

[previewyoutube=hDQkY1izqp4;full][/previewyoutube]

You can go and grab your own copy right now! We have prepared a list of special bundles – link coming soon! You can find a great deal for yourself and get Dinosaur Fossil Hunter alongside another game at a discount!

That’s not all! We promised you a discount depending on the results of our Wishlist Challenge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/1279dd6fb3dde6c90211f802476ea21fea5e4305.png

We’re happy to let you all know that Dinosaur Fossil Hunter found its way to over 100 000 Wishlists! That means a 10% launch discount will be applied to the game’s initial price! Thank you so much for every single click on that “Add to Wishlist” button!

Another event that comes to a close is our Screenshot Competition. 

The author of a winning entry is AlesioN_R on Twitter – if said person is now reading this, you can expect a Twitter DM from us soon along with keys to Barn Finders, Rover Mechanic Simulator and Tank Mechanic Simulator. Your wonderful exhibition will also be featured in Dinosaur Fossil Hunter! Congratulations! 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/10adc3a9d9a8f0a822fb9ed829a7050b8aef4a88.png

After 4 years of development, we can finally hand over this game to you. It has been a long journey and we hope you’ll enjoy the results of our work. We’re looking forward to your feedback, so don’t be shy and share your suggestions with us on Steam forums and our other social media. The upcoming days will surely be busy for us, but we’ll do our best to get back to you as soon as we can!

Rest assured that this journey is not over! We’ll be taking your suggestions into consideration while planning future updates for the game. In the next few days, you can expect to see a roadmap with details regarding first updates after the launch. 

Take a look at some of the pictures taken during the development of this game as well as during events we were participating in. During those 4 years a lot has happened – some team members got married, others had children, some of our former team members have left while we’ve welcomed a lot of new faces in our ranks. Most importantly, during all this time, each one of us learned a lot! 

Our journey took us to many places and we met many wonderful people along the way. We visited natural history museums, as well as real excavation site.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/79e1e9afad36f8919b3d3ea84bee5cb644258f3e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/9b2be1d7693c6232850d64478f59ffe90ac0d375.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/a0e4c58714558a4108755137fc5c46f51b141a31.jpg

Our stops also included various gaming events and even though not everything worked out during difficult times of COVID pandemic, Dinosaur Fossil Hunter traveled around Poland and even made its way to some of the events overseas!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/ff7609f4185ddb211cebf7cae953a19e85256fc0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/39f717457078e129b6e630c1f6765df206fb3748.jpg

Let’s not forget about our team mascot - The Dino who cheered up a lot of people. 🦖 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/d84886bada404f5f8e8b5989dacbde7d24f03dac.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/8b1558c17d87018df79fbc03a08ccec6436d8d86.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/f997f05b557bd1a2d0108bd6eba106706e2af969.jpg

Thank you, everyone! It’s thanks to you and all of these little encounters over the years that helped us shape Dinosaur Fossil Hunter into the game you can play today!

We hope you will enjoy the results of this amazing adventure together with us! 🙂

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter

notes.title: May the 4th be with you!
notes.content:
Hello, Fossil Hunters!

A lot has happened since the time of our release date announcement. It turned out that April is bringing to the table many great games. After careful consideration, the decision was made to postpone release of our Dinosaur Fossil Hunter for one more week. 

The new release date is 4 May 2022!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/ff586ee21c8edf1cdd01659ce5512bb732d9f800.png

We’d like to tell you about many additions that are coming to the full version of the game!

NEW FEATURES: 

Even more languages!

With the help from our amazing translators, we can expand the list of supported languages! 
We will include the following additional languages:

 Japanese
 Korean
 Turkish
 Dutch
 Portuguese

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/78ab635b21a522c999ccfb8e6ca41854bd7a6873.png

Partial Steam Workshop Support

That’s a big spoiler, but we thought that many of you might be happy to know that we have included partial Workshop support in our game! Are you happy with your museum exhibitions? You’ll be able to share your museum in Steam Workshop and allow other players to visit it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/bc107f64e2b5af77e7e872b98f72a0ec90f4bd12.png

Voice-over

Our protagonist now has a voice! For the full immersion and to enhance the narrative part of the game, the narration in text will now be accompanied by a voice of the lector. We hope this will make your experience even more magical.


Achievements

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter will include over 70 Achievements for all the achievement hunters out there! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/f8f9868cad1097498d8107d59d4f2207a872639f.png

IMPROVEMENTS:

Improved Tutorial

We know that tutorial plays a big role in shaping first impressions about the game. That’s why we do our best to gather feedback at every possible stage. For a long time, our QA team has been our primary source of feedback but thanks to our recent playtests we were finally able to hand the game over to you – our players! We have gathered a lot of invaluable suggestions and based on that, tutorial in the full game will be improved. One of the more notable changes is that instead of static graphics, Help panels will now include short recordings showing certain features in action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/0f72379a5cc2bf8072f193863a6e2ecd18649274.gif

Waypoints

More waypoints and additional information such as room and location descriptions have been added in order to make it easier for you to find your way. You don’t have to worry about getting lost as the game will be sure to nudge you in the right direction if needed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/7bcdb80436e2710f021636199c933b9ef31b7bf1.png

Controller support

We have been working on controller support system for quite a while now and playtests allowed us to address many issues so in the future, you'll be able play the game the way you like. Would you like to use your favourite game controller? Go for it! You'll be able to choose from dedicated settings for Xbox 360, PS 4, PS 5 and Xbox One controller, as well as set up your own configuration.

Upgraded mechanics

A lot of in-game mechanics have been improved thanks to our playtesters, including a water pump, which should be much more intuitive to use in the full version of the game.

https://i.imgur.com/6miJb92.gif

WISHLIST CHALLENGE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/1279dd6fb3dde6c90211f802476ea21fea5e4305.png

Remember about the Wishlist Challenge! 

If you’re looking forward to Dinosaur Fossil Hunter, we encourage you to add the game to your Wishlist! Not only you’ll be notified as soon as the game is available, but you’ll bring us closer to one of the challenge goals listed above! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif

Depending on the goal we reach by the release day, a corresponding launch discount will be applied to the game’s initial price!

SCREENSHOT COMPETITION

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/2263a3464bbbddbf8e6dac3632373cf53ba39a09.png

In one of our last announcements, we also mentioned Screenshot Competition. With release date changed to 4 May, deadline of the competition has been moved to May 4 as well. You have one more week to submit your entry. 

Is there any exhibition that you’re particularly fond of in Dinosaur Fossil Hunter: Prologue? Take a screenshot and share it with us on Twitter! Make sure to include #DinosaurFossilHunter hashtag so we can locate it. 

3 winning entries will be featured in the game, while their authors will receive keys to these great games:

 Barn Finders
 Rover Mechanic Simulator
 Tank Mechanic Simulator

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/8b530ae2d15e69ac466d98d70a30973849c96a3f.png

You can find more information about the competition here.

You can also expect a detailed roadmap of future updates on the game’s release day. 

May the 4th be with you! 🙂

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Wishlist Challenge & Screenshot Competition
notes.content:
Hello, Fossil Hunters!

A little bit over 2 weeks keep us from Dinosaur Fossil Hunter release day! I hope you have already noted it down somewhere, but just in case, let us give you a friendly reminder – the full game will be released on April 27!

To fill some time until that day, we’ve decided to hold two special events.

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Wishlist Challenge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/1279dd6fb3dde6c90211f802476ea21fea5e4305.png

Have you added our game to your Wishlist? If you haven’t, please do so – it’s just a single click and having our games added to Wishlist means a world to indie developers like us. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif

Moreover, if you know someone who would be interested in the game, we’d appreciate it if you could point them in the right direction.😊 Depending on how many people have Dinosaur Fossil Hunter in their Wishlist on the release day, a corresponding discount will be applied to the price.

Fingers crossed we can reach those goals!

Now, as for the other event, we’d like to announce…

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Screenshot Competition with Rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/2263a3464bbbddbf8e6dac3632373cf53ba39a09.png

Some of you might recall our previous contest back from the Prologue days, Dinosaur Drawing Competition. You can read about it here and take a look at the winning entries here. 

We had a great time and we were looking forward to another opportunity to hold such a contest! Now, we’d like to dedicate our contest to museum exhibitions.

Here's how to enter:

[olist]
 Play Dinosaur Fossil Hunter: Prologue and set up the most wonderful dinosaur exhibition! 🦖🌴✨
 Post your drawing on Twitter along with a hashtag #DinosaurFossilHunter
[/olist]
We will announce the winners on May 4. Winning entries will be featured on our Social Media channels and in the full version of Dinosaur Fossil Hunter!

Before taking part in our competition, make sure to check the rules:

Rules:
[olist]
 Screenshots must be taken in Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Prologue (NOT the Beta playtest version). 
 The screenshot contest starts on April 11 (right at the time when this information has been posted 😉) and ends on May 4 at 7 PM CEST.
 You can only submit 1 entry, so choose the best screenshot carefully!
 The best entries will only be chosen from screenshots posted on Twitter. Screenshots from other social media sites won’t be taken into account. That said, if you’d like to show us your work on Facebook or Discord as well, then go ahead! We’ll be happy to see it! ❤️
 The 3 winners will be announced on May 4 and we will share their entries on our Social Media channels: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Discord and Steam
 Each winner will also receive 3 game keys to following games: 

 Rover Mechanic Simulator 
 Tank Mechanic Simulator 
 Barn Finders

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/8b530ae2d15e69ac466d98d70a30973849c96a3f.png
[/olist]
If you have more questions regarding the competition, please contact us on Discord or in the comments section of this article.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png

Good luck!
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Devlog #24: Testing underway
notes.content:
Hello, Fossil Hunters!

It’s time to give you an update on development progress! 

Before we do that, though, we’d like to apologize for not publishing anything in December – due to Christmas time and New Year’s Eve it was difficult to squeeze in a devlog during that time. We know some of you have been used to a monthly pace and the delay made you confused. We’d like to make it clear that the game is constantly being worked on. It’s a bit late now, but we’d also like to wish you a Happy New Year! 🙂

Now, let’s move to the part you’re all interested in. 

What is the game’s current state?

We are happy to let you know that the majority of mechanics and content has been included in the game. We are intensively working on wrapping up development and preparing for the game’s launch. 

https://i.imgur.com/zkwzz9o.gif

We have now moved to the testing phase – many of our testers are involved along with the QA team of our publisher. They play the game and give us their feedback while we provide them with new builds and polish the game according to their suggestions. It’s a very intense time as we hand over at least one new build each day. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/cbc42db47b6de2c717105aea6c7510fe8cd4378a.jpg

Main mechanics and gameplay loop have been completed and all 3D content has been included in the game. Locations have been finished as well. Prologue’s content has been successfully merged with the full game’s content and the story has been expanded. Most of the less important mechanics work well, although they require a bit more testing and polishing. We’re also adding remaining 2D graphics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/29d475ac761359b985b7f4f7fe8ff494f80d1a4e.jpg

Fortunately, new workflow related to excavating big fossils received positive feedback from the entire publisher’s testing team, which means we can focus on improvements and adding missing elements to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/cbc42db47b6de2c717105aea6c7510fe8cd4378a.jpg

To be specific, other than obligatory fixes, we’re working on:

 2D graphics, such as icons, screenshots and Achievements graphics
 Music
 Improving some of the game’s interface
 Translating new text content
 Gameplay balance
 Analyzing and improving optimization
 Completing remaining minor mechanics

As the end note, we’d like to show you one of the most advanced systems we have developed for Dinosaur Fossil Hunter – rocks excavation system. It was a great challenge to get it right, but we’re very happy with the results. 

https://i.imgur.com/wG5C7Y4.gif

This system evaluates whether it is possible or not to dig out the rock based on the terrains’ shape.

That would be it for this devlog! We can’t say how long testing will take as it’s a constant loop of creating a build, gathering feedback, improving, creating another build and so on. It takes time, but thanks to the efforts of our testers, we can eliminate a lot of bugs and possible issues you could face. Once this phase is over, we can start preparing for the launch. 

Just a bit longer – stay tuned!

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Devlog #23: Development status
notes.content:
Hello, Fossil Hunters!

https://i.imgur.com/GtjzOe5.gif

It’s about time to give you an update from the development front! 😃

EGX provided us with loads of valuable feedback. We’ve gathered everything we had learned by talking with players and our own observations and now we’re putting it to use. Unfortunately, as it usually is with development, whenever something is added to the game, some additional time is needed to address all the issues that pop up as a result. Rest assured, with our testing team aboard, we’ll prevail! 

https://i.imgur.com/TE4nsSC.gif

We may not be able to provide you with many truly new things, but we believe there is still a fair share of interesting things to show you. Let’s go!

https://i.imgur.com/3v9FPM4.gif

When you get to the excavation site, you need to secure the area. Before, you had to hold the Space button for a while – now, you can either proceed like before or simply press a button to skip this sequence and move on to the next step.

https://i.imgur.com/beBdYaS.gif

We have polished the look of various animations you encounter during your fossil hunting. Now they look more natural. Take a look!

https://i.imgur.com/4oiOi4S.gif
https://i.imgur.com/NTflTAv.gif

Other than that, we have improved rock destroying mechanic. It works similarly to how it did before, but now it’s possible to destroy rocks other than the ones you encounter on the roads. For example, you can destroy rocks that get in your way while digging for paleontological treasures!

https://i.imgur.com/G1d9DZg.gif

Rock inspection has also been improved! Thanks to your feedback, Giger’s counter role has been expanded. After finding the rock with a fossil, you’ll need to perform a visual inspection, which will allow you to find places where the fossil sticks out of the rock. 

https://i.imgur.com/2r6a6oB.gif

When you find and prepare your fossil for a journey back home, it’s time to move it to the car! Medium boxes come with this neat cover right here:

https://i.imgur.com/CuSaJiG.gif

While you’re already familiar with most of the game’s features, there is another one that will give you some room for customization. We have added the option to change the colour of your vehicle. You can freely change the colour of any car you can control in the game. Just make sure to make this colour pleasing for the eyes. 😉

https://i.imgur.com/Z20AblC.gif

We have also been working on including controller support in the game, as we recall that it’s something that a lot of you requested in the past. 🙂

What’s left now is to get rid of those pesky bugs and at last, get the game ready for you – our players and hope that this adventure we’ve been working so hard on will make you fall in love with paleontology all over again!

As a last piece of news for today, Dinosaur Fossil Hunter was chosen as one of ten Polish games to show up at WePlay Expo in Shanghai! The Prologue version will be presented during the event, which will take place on December 11-12. While we won’t be able to be there in person due to COVID restrictions, our game will be left in WePlay organizing party's care. If you haven’t tried the updated Prologue yet and have the opportunity to drop by, please do! 🙂

If you're not on our Discord server yet, we encourage you to join the community!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Devlog #22: Improvements and a special feature!
notes.content:
We’re back, Fossil Hunters!

Along with us, we bring you another update regarding our progress on the game! 🤠

Our team continues working on the game’s balance, fixing and further improving the game by adding missing features. Balancing the game requires a lot of attention and cooperation from our development and testing team. Testers play and leave invaluable feedback, which our development team uses to adjust gameplay accordingly. It’s a continuous cycle, which – little by little – allows us to bring Dinosaur Fossil Hunter closer to completion.

In the past month, our team has grown considerably bigger as new dedicated team members have joined our ranks. 💪💪💪 With their help, we gained more time, which in turn allowed us to reconsider some of your suggestions and include them in the game.

Some of the aforementioned features include:

 making your character visible at certain stages of the game,
 adding a possibility to draw a path on the minimap,
 reworked mechanics of securing an excavation site, which should now be more pleasing to watch,
 adding belts to hold crates on top of your car in place,
 improved vehicle physics.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/2662d1abbc468b1ea4fcec52e7336df10634efe5.png

Moreover, we have decided to do something special for our community. Our Kickstarter supporters may recall “Little Findings” listed among our stretch goals. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/2371b69450d983729d28773975e7d2a8b1a5fe56.png

Unfortunately, the campaign ended with a sum just a tiny bit away from that goal and we thought we wouldn’t be able to include it in the game. However, with more people on board, Dinosaur Fossil Hunter team decided to bring this idea to life! We have already prepared over 20 unique fossils, which will make great additions to your museum displays! We are currently working on a way to transport these new fossils from an excavation site to a museum. 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/cb97954029efae24788df3d2808ddedddf6f8394.jpg

Keep in mind that’s not all! We have many more surprises in store for you, but we don’t want to spill out everything just yet. We’d like to leave some things for you to discover. 🙂

If you’re looking for a community of paleontology enthusiasts to talk about the game, consider joining or Discord channel! Like always, we also encourage you to add Dinosaur Fossil Hunter to your Wishlist – that is, if it’s not there yet. 😄

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter - Development Status & Holiday Greetings
notes.content:
Dear Paleontologists!

Since the beginning our goal was to create a fun Paleontologist Simulator - a unique game the world hasn't seen before. At the beginning of 2019, after long planning, we've started the production of this game and prepared a lot of content, then we decided to prepare Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Demo Version to gather feedback about the game. Thanks to this Kickstarter and the great Community, we received many ideas on how to improve the game.

The next step was preparing The Prologue with polished core gameplay and longer plot which introduced players to our game. Releasing The Prologue gave as an amazing opportunity to gather valuable feedback and many awesome ideas worth adding to the game, which would greatly enrich the gameplay.

In conclusion, after reading almost all your comments and discussing the feedback, we've decided to add some big changes to the game based on suggestions that you've posted on Kickstarter, Steam and Discord, but adding these changes and improvements requires additional time. However, we believe that this will make our game even more pleasant and satisfying. 

Aside from originally planned features you will additionally find a lot of new things in the game,  the most important changes we decided to add are:
  Player XP progress with skill tree	
 Museum progress with upgrades	
 Ability to shorten exploration or preparation phases depending on player level
 Different bone workflows for small and medium sized bones with completely redesigned, more immersive look
It wasn't an easy decision, mainly because of one important reason - it extends the production time of the game, which is inconvenient both for you and for us. We need to reach the „roots” of the game and rebuild part of the mechanics, for example to enable player progress during gameplay. This means that we will not be able to deliver the game to you as we previously planned - in December.

We hope to deliver Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Early Access to you in Q1 2021. We know that many of you are looking forward to the game and you wanted to play during Christmas. Despite these hard times, we're doing our best to deliver the game as fast as we possibly can, created by passionate players for players. After the Christmas break, we will provide you with more details regarding the development status. 

We are convinced that adding those changes was the right decision and we believe that longer development will definitely have a positive impact on the game that we're creating together with you. Every day we also work on Kickstarter goals to implement as many of them as possible before the release day. Thank you for your trust and understanding.


and one more thing...

Merry Christmas!

Christmas is just around the corner! May the Christmas Season bring only happiness and joy to you and your family. We wish you a Merry Christmas! 🎄

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/29c15ce4a7daac8b3d4a51eea15dd0ec9c84c312.png

Stay safe and take care during the Christmas Season! 
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team
